items.label: Cross-band Style Design
items.value: Open Toe and Adjustable Cross-band style design could not only adjust the tightness but also could add the stability of the slippers, not easy to fall off. Relieve sore feet, and can be worn with or barefoot.

items.label: High-density Coral Fleece Upper and Lining
items.value: When you slip on the fuzzy arch support slippers, you will get a luxurious feeling like step on the wool carpet, brings a new wearing experience.

items.label: Three-points Supportive PU Insole
items.value: Metatarsal pad, arch support, and deep heel cup can distribute force on the front of human feet to each part of feet that can cause therapeutic and orthotic effects. Especially for the group who has the issue of Plantar Fasciitis, Flat Foot, Heel Pain, Foot Pain, Diabetes, and Arthritis.

items.label: Anti-slip TPU Outsole
items.value: Fabric-covered TPU outsole with wave pattern, which enhances the traction and durability. As well as it has extra shock absorption.Perfect for every season with indoor/outdoor use.

items.label: Easy Care
items.value: Machine washing and dryer are allowed, the fabric is easy to clean whatever stain or dust. Don’t be afraid of fading.
